newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary 96 prelim GDP growth estimate under 1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary 96 prelim GDP growth estimate under 1 pct.

text.p: The annual growth rate for Hungary's gross domestic product (GDP) for 1996 should not exceed one percent, government spokesman Elemer Kiss said on Friday.
"The growth of the economy will not exceed one percent," Kiss told a news conference after the weekly cabinet meeting.
Hungary's GDP growth fell to one percent in Q1 1996 year on year.
Kiss also said the government expected two percent GDP growth in 1997.
